***About AS214240***

***AS214240*** operates a UK distributed network designed for low latency, high availability, and efficient traffic management/scalability. We maintain our own backbone infrastructure in across the UK and into Europe. All routes are shared within multiple tier 1 providers and IXs to ensure consistent reachability and resilience.

Routing decisions may vary by location based on capacity, network conditions, or our/your operational requirements.

**Use of Peering Automation**

BGP sessions are automatically configured based on data from PeeringDB and other similar services such as RADB. Please ensure your entry is accurate and current prior to requesting peering with us.

**Our Interconnection Policy**

We support interconnection via physical connections at shared facilities or through our connected internet exchange fabrics. Virtual and tunnel peering is only supported in certain strategic circumstances.
